blockers.description: Machine sleep repeatedly killed subagents mid-run (~8 deaths in one hour). Root cause identified: agents died inside long advisor() calls.
blockers.workaround: Brief every review subagent with an explicit 'do NOT call an advisor, do NOT spawn sub-agents' rule, and order the checks by priority with 'report as soon as you have answers to the first N'.

context_notes: Standing method that produced every real finding this session: never read-and-agree. Reproduce the claim, and for any proof change run the mutation on BOTH base and head — a mutation killed at base but surviving at head is the headline finding. For docs-only PRs the analysis IS the deliverable, so every citation, count and line range gets verified against the tree. Two traps hit repeatedly: git log --all sweeps fetched PR refs so 'already used' claims must be checked against origin/main; and stale .d.mts/.d.ts shadow sources, so purge them (pruning node_modules, which may be a symlink into the shared clone) before any tsc probe.
